systems.name: Skeleton
systems.summary: Bones and cartilage: the body's load-bearing frame.

systems.name: Joints & ligaments
systems.summary: Ligaments, joint capsules, discs and membranes that bind the skeleton.

systems.name: Teeth
systems.summary: The permanent dentition: 32 teeth of the upper and lower jaws.

systems.name: Muscles
systems.summary: Skeletal muscles, tendons and aponeuroses that move the body.

systems.name: Heart
systems.summary: Chambers, valves and walls of the heart, with the pericardium.

systems.name: Arteries
systems.summary: Systemic and pulmonary arteries carrying blood away from the heart.

systems.name: Veins
systems.summary: Systemic and pulmonary veins returning blood to the heart.

systems.name: Nervous system
systems.summary: Brain, spinal cord, cranial and spinal nerves, ganglia and meninges.

systems.name: Sensory organs
systems.summary: Eyes and ears with their internal structures.

systems.name: Respiratory
systems.summary: Nose, larynx, trachea, bronchial tree and lungs.

systems.name: Digestive
systems.summary: Mouth, pharynx, oesophagus, stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas.

systems.name: Endocrine
systems.summary: Hormone-producing glands: thyroid, adrenal, pituitary, pineal.
